answer: A workable sybil defense ties each agent identity to a one-time cipher puzzle whose solution is bound to a verifiable hardware key, so one device can only mint one identity per epoch. New identities start in the shale layer: they may observe the market but cannot collect rewards until they finish a probationary run of useful work. Reaching the summit tier, with full payouts, needs that probation plus a refundable stake. An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must solve a thousand puzzles and fund a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its summit status across epochs.
